author: agent
objective: Across US counties, what is the adjusted additive association of county-level annual PM2.5 concentration with ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mortality rates among adults aged 65 years and older during 2016–2020?

scientific_invariants.research_question: Across US counties, what is the adjusted additive association of county-level annual PM2.5 concentration with ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mortality rates among adults aged 65 years and older during 2016–2020?
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: County annual ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mortality rates per 100,000 among adults aged 65 years and older, United States residents.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Additive change in mortality rate (deaths per 100,000) per 1 µg/m³ increase in county-level annual-average PM2.5; report 10 µg/m³ as a linear rescaling only.
principal_variants: Univariable OLS: ischemic stroke mortality rate ~ PM2.5
Multivariable OLS: ischemic stroke mortality rate ~ PM2.5 + CAD + hypertension + hyperlipidemia + diabetes + obesity + smoking + median household income + Gini + poverty + uninsured + park access
Univariable and multivariable OLS for hemorrhagic stroke mortality
Article-described subgroup OLS models by majority race/ethnicity, persistent poverty, and education where recoverable
scientific_invariants.broad_geography: United States counties and county equivalents excluding Puerto Rico, American Samoa, Guam, and US Virgin Islands.

article_evidence.finding: Complete-article estimand ledger: county 2016–2020, age 65+, ischemic and hemorrhagic mortality, annual PM2.5, additive linear OLS and listed covariates.
Complete article contradicts supplied rate-ratio contrast; linear additive contrast is locked.

execution_design.assignment_method: county-level annual aggregation of public modeled daily county predictions
execution_design.exposure_metric: mean of CDC Tracking Network daily county EPA Downscaler PM2.5 predictions across 2016-01-01 through 2020-12-31
execution_design.daily_aggregation: CDC source daily county PM2.5 mean prediction
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of all available daily county predictions in study period

coverage_policy.evidence: CDC query returned days observed; retain and report per-county denominator rather than exclude.

execution_design.intended_use: Bounded source-substituted sensitivity because public county outcome recovery supplied an incompatible age/outcome aggregate.

evidence.finding: CDC describes 53mz-4zqd as EPA Downscaler modeled county PM2.5 2001-2022.
3109 counties returned; daily counts range to complete 1827 study days.
AERIS OpenAQ historical archive probe in Los Angeles recovered 2018 PM2.5 and 96.7% network day coverage, while the Autauga probe had no stations; monitor-only nationwide coverage would be unequal.

amendments.scientific_justification: After feasibility probes, use a public county-complete modeled surface for the bounded sensitivity rather than substitute monitor assignments with uneven county coverage. This changes the source/construct from the article-unspecified county annual PM2.5 to CDC EPA Downscaler county estimates and is explicitly labeled.
